checkpoint.title: Lavender Mart, then west over Route 8 on the Bicycle, the Underground Path, a Pidgey on Route 7, Celadon's Pokemon Center
notes: PokeGuy's way from Lavender Town to Celadon City (pokeguy 54:18 on): the Lavender Mart, Route 8 west on the BICYCLE (00.26), Gamer Rich, the Underground Path's east-west tunnel to Route 7, a Pidgey from Route 7's grass to carry HM02 Fly later, and Celadon's Pokemon Center.

No Repel: the way keeps off grass. Route 8's grass (34..46, 9..18) is penned in by the Cut trees (47, 12) and (33, 15); Route 7's (11..18, 2..6) is east of the way north from the Underground Path's door (7, 14). The Underground Path has no wild Pokemon (pokefirered wild_encounters.json lists none), and the Pidgey is caught where Route 7's grass is walked on purpose.

Route 8's trainers (Route8 map.json): Julia (62, 14) looks west 6, Rich (55, 15) south 3, Glenn (51, 6) all ways 4, Paige (29, 3) and Andrea (29, 5) west 3, Leslie (29, 4) and Megan (29, 6) east 6, Stan (21, 3) all ways 1, Eli and Anne (40, 3), (41, 3) south 1, Ricardo (14, 16) and Jaren (24, 17) all ways 1, Aidan (9, 6) east 4. Below the wall (56..61, 6..13) the only ways west are row 14, Julia's line, and rows 15..18, which cross Rich's column: his line (55, 16..18) is the one taken.
